Resolution submitted to ascertain the view of members of the People's Majlis on the matter of three Supreme Court justices being removed from office on the basis of allegations without any evidentiary basis.

Introduction

Although more than a year has passed since three Supreme Court justices were removed from office following an investigation into allegations that they abused their influence, the Prosecutor General's Office decided on 30 September 2026 not to press criminal charges, as the evidence and circumstantial evidence found in the investigation of this case did not indicate that a criminal offence had been committed. As this reveals that those justices were removed from office on the basis of allegations without any evidentiary basis, this is a resolution submitted under Article 189 of the Rules of Procedure of the Majlis to ascertain the view of members of the 20th People's Majlis on this matter.

Resolution

Whereas Article 22(a) of Law No. 13/2010 (Judges Act of the Maldives) states that a judge may be removed from office [?] when he seriously violates the principles of the code of conduct that judges must abide by;
